start: A member with 20 finished workouts, on the Workout tab

user_sees: Title 'Profile' with buttons 'Edit profile', 'Share this month as a picture' and Settings
Photo or initials, the name, and three numbers 'Workouts', 'Streak' (weeks) and 'Records'
The history chart with its metric and range chips
must_not: 'NaN' or a minus number in Workouts, Streak or Records
An endless grey skeleton when the database is fine

user_sees: Rows 'Charts', 'Exercises', 'Records', 'Body', one row per month with a report
A 'Calendar' row and the badge shelf
must_not: A row that opens a page that no longer exists

steps.action: Scroll down the workouts feed and tap a workout card
user_sees: Month lines such as 'October · 12 workouts' over the cards
The workout's own page opens
must_not: The same workout twice in the feed
Older workouts that never load at the bottom

start: A chart on the Profile tab, a week bar with workouts

steps.action: Tap the bar, then 'See these workouts' (opens the old /history link with a from and to date)
user_sees: Page 'Your workouts' with a line saying how many workouts in that week, month or day
One card per workout of that range
must_not: The page redirecting to Profile when a range was given

user_sees: The Profile tab

start: Profile tab, a member who has earned 3 badges

user_sees: Page 'Badges' with the line '3 of N earned'
Badges not earned yet read 'Not earned yet' to a screen reader
must_not: An earned badge shown as locked
The count line missing once the list has loaded

start: Profile tab, a member without MettleUp Plus while the free-plan chart limit is switched on

steps.action: Pick a chart range longer than 3 months
user_sees: A pop-up that explains long charts are part of MettleUp Plus
A way on to the MettleUp Plus page
must_not: A gym member (who gets Plus free) seeing the pop-up

steps.action: Tap the profile link under the bio when the link cannot be opened
user_sees: Message 'Couldn’t open the link' with 'Check it in Edit profile.'
must_not: A crash or nothing at all

start: A brand-new member with no workouts, who had the old Progress tab before the update

user_sees: A note saying where the old Progress tab went, with 'Got it'
'No workouts yet. Each one you finish shows here.'
'Your monthly report and year in review show here after your first workout.'
must_not: A blank feed with no words
A month report row for a month with no workouts

steps.action: Tap 'Got it', finish a first workout, come back to Profile
user_sees: The note is gone and stays gone
Workouts shows 1 and the new workout heads the feed
must_not: The note coming back on the next visit
The old empty line still shown next to the new workout

start: Profile tab, a member who logs body weight

steps.action: Tap 'Share this month as a picture', then share it to WhatsApp
user_sees: A picture of this month's workouts and records
The phone's share sheet
must_not: Body weight, or numbers that divide back to body weight, on the picture
The member's phone number or gym name without their choice
